appearance_facts.fact: The chart contains five distinct blue circular data points arranged in a diagonal line ascending from the bottom-left to the top-right.
The lowest data point is located at approximately x=25 and y=30, labeled 'January'.
The second data point is located at approximately x=35 and y=50, labeled 'February'.
The third data point is located at approximately x=45 and y=85, labeled 'March'.
The fourth data point is located at approximately x=55 and y=140, labeled 'April'.
The highest data point is located at approximately x=65 and y=220, labeled 'May'.

printed_facts.fact: The title reads 'Advertising Budget vs Revenue (High-Performing Regions)'.
The y-axis is labeled 'Revenue ($)' and has tick marks at intervals of 20, ranging from 0 to 220.
The x-axis is labeled 'Advertising Budget ($)' and has tick marks at intervals of 10, ranging from 0 to 70.
Each data point has a text label directly above it indicating a month: 'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', and 'May'.
